Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6) • Install: Hospital

A cutting-edge Kiroshi prototype, designed to emulate its namesake — you look at something, it dies.

Iconic Paired Cybereyes. They must be installed together and count as a single item for the purposes of Cost and Humanity Loss but not Critical Injuries or repair.

Each Cybereye has 2 Option Slots for Cybereye Options. Each comes with preinstalled Color Shift, Image Enhance, and Low Light/Infrared/UV. None of the preinstalled options can be removed without destroying the cybereyes beyond repair.

While installed, once per Round when the user inflicts a random Critical Injury onto a target (e.g., not a Leg Aimed Shot), they may choose which Critical Injury to inflict instead of rolling on the table.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Type: Cybereye
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 0, provides 2

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.
  • One item for the pair, as Corgo prices and installs them together. It carries 2 Option Slots, the count for one eye; add a second copy or raise the slots by hand if your table tracks each eye.
  • The three pre-installed options are described here rather than installed as separate items.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
